infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to access the camera for barcode scanning.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to access the photos you choose so you can attach them to workouts, feed posts, chats, and your profile photo.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to access the specific photos you select so we can upload them to workouts, feed posts, chats, or your profile photo; nothing is shared automatically.
